referenceMethod: Each surface interleaved maxConcurrency 1/2/4 over one first process and five warm OS-cache new processes per value; no cache clearing.

qualification.applyLimitsTo: every first and warm sample; no best-run selection

rationale: Reference maxima plus roughly 20-40 percent wall and memory headroom on this host. Optional parallelism showed lower warm medians on both surfaces, but serial remains the default and no minimum speedup is required. Synthetic cancellation and assembly-worker budgets remain in 0.6-budget.json; this IFX chain has declaration rules only and no measured IFX cancellation latency.
acceptanceBoundary: Real IFX declaration-only chain on the reviewed host and frozen existing/offline input. Source binding is absent and results are partial/compliant/exit 4. These ceilings do not certify other machines, SDK builds, assembly workers, cancellation, full current-source compliance or launcher/manual usability. Calibration samples cannot qualify their own newly frozen limits.
